questions.question: Xu’s notification formats in scope are:
options: Only carrier pigeons and fax machines.
Mobile push, SMS, and email.
Only in-process log lines with no user delivery.
Only browser localStorage writes on the same device.
questions.explanation: mobile push notification, SMS message, and Email

questions.question: iOS push delivery commonly goes through:
options: A random public MQTT broker with no auth.
Apple Push Notification Service (APNS) using device token + payload.
Direct SMS gateways that ignore device tokens.
FTP uploads to each phone overnight.

questions.question: Android push in Xu’s overview commonly uses:
options: APNS exclusively for all Android devices.
Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) as a common path.
APNS exclusively for all Android devices as well.
Direct SQL inserts into the phone’s SQLite over the open internet.

questions.question: Contact info gathering stores device tokens separately because:
options: A user can have multiple devices that should all receive pushes.
Device tokens must never be associated with a user id.
Email and SMS cannot be stored in any database table.
APNS forbids persisting tokens longer than one second.
questions.explanation: A user can have multiple devices
